# X_lora = -X_pi + offset*cos(yaw) + DeltaX;
# Y_lora = -Y_pi + offset*sin(yaw) + DeltaY.
# The competition preset uses zero: the air-side/Pi chain already owns its
# mounting correction, preventing a double application.
